options.name: action
options.description: The action to take. Creating OSDs and zapping or querying devices.

options.name: batch_devices
options.description: A list of devices to pass to the 'ceph-volume lvm batch' subcommand. Only applicable if action is 'batch'.

options.name: block_db_devices
options.description: A list of devices for bluestore block db to pass to the 'ceph-volume lvm batch' subcommand. Only applicable if action is 'batch'.

options.name: block_db_size
options.description: The size in bytes of bluestore block db lvs. The default of -1 means to create them as big as possible. Only applicable if action is 'batch'.

options.name: cluster
options.description: The ceph cluster name.

options.name: crush_device_class
options.description: Will set the crush device class for the OSD.

options.name: data
options.description: The logical volume name or device to use for the OSD data.

options.name: data_vg
options.description: If data is a lv, this must be the name of the volume group it belongs to.

options.name: db
options.description: A partition or logical volume name to use for block.db.

options.name: db_vg
options.description: If db is a lv, this must be the name of the volume group it belongs to.

options.name: destroy
options.description: TBD

options.name: dmcrypt
options.description: If set to True the OSD will be encrypted with dmcrypt.

options.name: objectstore
options.description: The objectstore of the OSD.

options.name: osd_fsid
options.description: The OSD FSID

options.name: osd_id
options.description: The OSD ID

options.name: osds_per_device
options.description: The number of OSDs to create per device. Only applicable if action is 'batch'.

options.name: report
options.description: If provided the --report flag will be passed to 'ceph-volume lvm batch'. No OSDs will be created. Results will be returned in json format. Only applicable if action is 'batch'.

options.name: wal
options.description: A partition or logical volume name to use for block.wal.

options.name: wal_devices
options.description: A list of devices for bluestore block wal to pass to the 'ceph-volume lvm batch' subcommand. Only applicable if action is 'batch'.

options.name: wal_vg
options.description: If wal is a lv, this must be the name of the volume group it belongs to.
